purpose: Make the existing replay's exact choices explicit; this document changes no trial inputs or computations
candidate_cap_equivalence: No additional manual cap is mathematically equivalent to the explicit 100% UI setting; risk and sleeve constraints remain active
lower_next_session_price: May buy more units within the same approved principal; this is not exact parity with a previously entered unit-count order
higher_next_session_price: Buys fewer units; never increases approved principal
missing_execution_price: Rejects the order and retains cash
budget: Prior unspent cash plus the new external monthly contribution; outside cash passed to the production finalizer is zero to avoid double counting
external_flows: Only the new monthly contribution issues additional portfolio accounting units
risk_gate_interpretation: Historical fixed-current-weight risk constraints at the decision date; not a bound on realized future losses, accumulated transaction-cost losses, or next-session price changes
